name: Gryshka's Letter
summary: Innkeeper Gryshka sends Zargh a note of thanks after receiving fresh meat from the Barrens. Her letter also introduces young Horde couriers to the wind rider routes.

sections.title: A Grateful Innkeeper
sections.body: Innkeeper Gryshka thanks Zargh for the steaks he sends from the Barrens to Orgrimmar. She remembers when he lost a finger preparing meat. Even bloodied by his trade, she tells him, he still looks handsome.

sections.title: Courier Along the Flight Paths
sections.body: To return Gryshka's Letter to the Crossroads, you report to Doras, the wind rider master atop Orgrimmar's plateau. Show him you have already checked in with Devrak at the Crossroads. Then Doras introduces young couriers to the wyvern flight paths linking settlements in Durotar and the Barrens.

faq.answer: Innkeeper Gryshka, who manages a tavern in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, wrote the letter after receiving fresh meat.

faq.q: Who is the letter intended for?
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to Zargh, a butcher at the Crossroads in the Barrens who supplied Gryshka with meat.

faq.q: What is written inside the letter?
faq.answer: Gryshka thanks Zargh for his cuts and recalls when he lost a finger preparing meat. She teases that he looks handsome even when bloodied.

faq.q: Why does Doras need to see the letter?
faq.answer: Doras is Orgrimmar's wind rider master. Gryshka sends you to show that you have checked in with Devrak at the Crossroads, so Doras can introduce you to the wyvern flight paths.

angles.text: Delivering Gryshka's Letter introduces young Horde adventurers to the wyvern flight network linking Durotar and the Barrens.
